experiments.hypothesis: A low-turnover, per-asset 180-day trend sign held for 28 days across five major USD-M perpetuals retains positive net expectancy after fees and funding when position weights are set from ex-ante 60-day volatility.
experiments.reason: Replace relative weekly ranking with independent monthly time-series trend and ex-ante volatility sizing.
experiments.reason_for_change: Alpha #6 lacked a robust cross-sectional edge; test a distinct absolute trend construction without tuning Alpha #6.

experiments.hypothesis: When the trailing seven-day funding differential between the highest- and lowest-funding major USD-M perpetual exceeds all modeled round-trip friction, a weekly equal-notional short-high/long-low spread earns positive net carry without requiring the outright crypto market direction.
experiments.reason: Test whether Alpha #5's positive funding component can survive with weekly cross-sectional turnover and opposing legs.
experiments.reason_for_change: Alpha #5's 1,009 trades lost most gross edge to fees; precommit a low-turnover funding spread instead of tuning its thresholds.

experiments.hypothesis: When BTCUSDT perpetual open interest expands unusually over 24 hours while price, funding, and realized volatility jointly indicate crowded long risk, the next eight-hour BTCUSDT return is negative enough for a fixed-horizon 1x short to retain positive expectancy after actual funding, taker fees, and modeled slippage.
experiments.reason: Independent derivatives-leverage crash-risk family backed by checksum-verifiable Binance open-interest metrics.

experiments.hypothesis: The sign of BTCUSDT taker order imbalance in the first ten seconds after selected quarter-hour boundaries predicts the same direction of the next twelve-hour return strongly enough for a non-overlapping 1x futures position to retain positive expectancy after taker fees, actual funding, and modeled slippage.
experiments.reason: Forward-only clock-phase order-flow family motivated by a 2026 Binance perpetual-futures study; non-overlapping execution is fixed before eligible data.

experiments.hypothesis: When the same asset's trailing seven-day Binance USD-M funding received by shorts exceeds a fixed all-in trading-friction hurdle and the perpetual is not below spot, a fully funded long-spot/short-perpetual position with identical base quantity earns positive net basis-plus-funding carry without outright crypto direction exposure.
experiments.reason: Independent same-asset spot/perpetual cash-and-carry family that removes Alpha #9's cross-asset direction residual before costs and funding are evaluated.

experiments.hypothesis: When the trailing seven-day funding differential among five major Binance USD-M perpetuals is at least 25 basis points, the lowest-funding contract outperforms the highest-funding contract over the following seven days strongly enough for an equal-notional long-low/short-high spread to retain positive price expectancy after actual funding, taker fees, and modeled slippage.
experiments.reason: Prospective-only test of the relative price component discovered after Alpha #9 failed its carry mechanism; no previously seen return may count.
experiments.reason_for_change: Experiment 0009 observed positive price PnL but failed because funding carry did not cover friction; this mechanism change therefore requires entirely new data.

experiments.hypothesis: Among five liquid Binance USDT markets, the perpetual contract with the largest contemporaneous spot-minus-perpetual log basis outperforms the contract with the smallest basis over the following 24 hours strongly enough for an equal-notional long-high-basis/short-low-basis spread to remain profitable after actual funding, taker fees, and modeled slippage.
experiments.reason: Development-only transfer test of the dated-futures basis result on Binance perpetuals; explicitly not an independent alpha or promotion sample.
experiments.reason_for_change: Alpha 009/013 use funding dispersion; Alpha 014 tests the related spot-minus-perpetual price basis daily, so fresh trial accounting is mandatory.

experiments.hypothesis: When BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual aggressive buy imbalance over the last completed ten minutes is at least +0.25 while BTCUSDT spot aggressive buy imbalance is at most -0.10, a delayed spot-only four-hour long hold has positive incremental net expectancy after fixed spot fees and slippage.
experiments.reason: First fixed test of delayed BTC spot performance following a completed spot/perpetual aggressive-flow disagreement; simulation only.
